en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Al Nowfaly, from Al Sakuny, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, from his<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> father<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>, from Jabir Bin Abdullah Al-Ansary who said, ‘Rasool-Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">saww</sup> said: ‘
The one who pleases a ruling authority by Angering Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>, would exit from the Religion of Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from al-Nawfali from al-Sakuni from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) from his father from Jabir ibn ‘Abd Allah (al-Ansari) who has said the following:
“The Messenger of Allah has said, ‘Whoever seeks the pleasure of a king by a means that anger Allah, has moved out of the religion of Allah.’”
